title: F*ck All The Way Off
description:
A Marine veteran interrupts a Senate hearing and suddenly becomes the latest internet martyr.

But who is Brian McGinnis really?

Steven Crowder digs into the viral protest, the media narrative forming around it, and the surprising connections that suggest this moment may have been more than just a spontaneous act of protest.
